summary: scripts/st-test --seed [REF] signs and pushes the per-crate rust-tests notes of REF's tree (default the base) for the crates that lack one, from any checkout, so a merge-queue signer can refresh main's tree after a merge that moved a crate key or the lane

replay.detail: CI and local tooling only; no product code changes.

compatibility.detail: No product contract change. The records are the ones st-test --check rust-tests already signs.
